name: MailFlow
description: One modern webmail inbox for Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP account

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (your accounts, synced mail and settings), the secret keys and the push notification keys. Back up the whole folder: without data/state, stored mail passwords can't be read.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: MailFlow web app and API, published on host as 6130

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you type in your browser. MailFlow works from any address, but links in invite and password reset emails, and single sign-on (OIDC), use this one. It starts as localhost. Change `localhost` to your server IP or your domain, like http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6130. Keep the port at 6130 unless you use a domain.
